# Weekly Saltwater Fishing Report

> Local-first weekly fishing-intelligence report for Southern California & Baja. Pipeline:
> pull YouTube transcripts headlessly (tools/yt_transcript.py; Chrome only as a per-video fallback)
> + scrape San Diego landing fish counts and long-range boat reports via the Chrome extension AND render a forward-looking Conditions briefing (wind / swell / SST / moon +
> temperature-break & water-color maps + a Storm Watch on named East Pacific tropical storms /
> hurricanes from NOAA NHC) from free public APIs -> one Day One journal entry, posted every Friday
> 9:02 AM Pacific. The Conditions section is rendered headlessly (no Chrome) by conditions.py; its
> text is pasted into the report VERBATIM and its images (maps, NHC 7-day outlook, forecast cones)
> are attached at save time from Day One's sandbox-readable inbox, positioned by [{attachment}].

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical guide for AI agents — what this repo is, the file map, the Conditions data contract, how the run works, how to extend, privacy + verification gates.
- [README.md](README.md): human quickstart and command reference.
- [BUILD-PLAN.md](BUILD-PLAN.md): architecture, the data sources we chose and why, and the hard findings (incl. the Day One sandbox attachment root cause, 2026-09-11).

## Conditions engine
- [conditions.py](conditions.py): self-contained generator — Open-Meteo numbers, NOAA MUR temp-break maps, VIIRS+OLCI gap-filled chlorophyll water-color maps, NOAA NHC Storm Watch (CurrentStorms.json + TCM advisories + TWO outlook, 7-day outlook + cone PNGs), ephem moon, Day One inbox staging, reportlab PDF. No Chrome, no login.
- [tools/dayone_attach.sh](tools/dayone_attach.sh): `inbox` (this run's attachable paths), `trigger <uuid>` (open the entry so Day One performs its lazy import; poll the photo count), `list`, `count`.
- [SPEC-conditions.md](SPEC-conditions.md): the Conditions data contract — regions, coordinates, data sources, the stdout format, and the PDF briefing.
- [requirements.txt](requirements.txt): Python dependencies for conditions.py.

## YouTube step
- [tools/yt_transcript.py](tools/yt_transcript.py): channel Atom feeds -> drop Shorts -> newest captioned upload in the window -> youtube_transcript_api -> youtube_transcripts/<stamp>/<key>.txt + manifest.json. One status line per channel; only FETCH_FAILED / FEED_FAILED go to the Chrome fallback in SKILL.md Part 1. Run with /usr/bin/python3.

## Task + scheduling
- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the full scheduled-task prompt — the report's operating instructions (sources, format, alerts).
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): project instructions, required connectors, and known behaviors.
- [SCHEDULE.md](SCHEDULE.md): how the weekly Cowork scheduled task is configured and edited.

## Key rules
- Conditions numbers + moon come from `conditions.py` stdout VERBATIM — never hand-write, estimate, or editorialize them.
- Wind is reported in KNOTS. Baja offshore values are MODELED (no buoys) and labeled as such.
- Day One (sandboxed App Store build) imports attachments only from inside its group container, lazily on first display. Attach the `<!-- ATTACHMENTS -->` inbox paths verbatim, keep every `[{attachment}]`, then `tools/dayone_attach.sh trigger <uuid>`. Never the clipboard-paste path (dead) or files outside the container (blank placeholders).
- Storm Watch tiers (IMPACT / WATCH / MONITOR) and the formation line are script output — verbatim, no re-grading.
- Tiered regions: always cover SoCal Bight / Northern Baja / San Clemente-Catalina; add offshore banks (Tanner/Cortez, Cedros/Guadalupe, Mag Bay, The Ridge, Alijos) ONLY when that week's reports mention them.
